cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's a small secret: I withdrew my application.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, where does that sentence go after you leave?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nowhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it may be safe to give it a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew my college application. Have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked. I said my sister's plans were hers to explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then there's more. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Call me. Mum uses my tablet; she'd see the message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. I'll call. It's Mum's old bakery. I want you there when I tell her.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's why prompts A3's confidentiality question, and B4's assurance licenses A5's conditional offer.

relationship.evidence: B2 shows curiosity, but B4's unqualified nowhere gives A no meaningful relational complication.

heightening.evidence: A5 stops before the deeper disclosure that would develop A1's trust test.

specificity.evidence: A1 names an application but leaves its purpose and B's connection unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's sentence going somewhere is concise, but A5 remains abstract and anticipatory.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 checks whether B told Mum, A3 discloses the bakery lease after B's discretion, and A5 reveals its family significance after another safeguard.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's defense of A's privacy earns A3's 'Then there's more'; B4's shared-tablet warning directly produces A5's agreement to call.

relationship.evidence: B2 establishes sibling loyalty while B4 contributes a credible household privacy problem; B supports A without becoming passive.

heightening.evidence: A5 reveals that the leased property is Mum's old bakery and asks B to attend the disclosure, increasing emotional involvement.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies the college decision and family stakes; B4's shared tablet gives the secrecy an immediately playable practical obstacle.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's address offer economically sets up B4's tablet warning and A5's family revelation; the effect is warm recognition more than a sharp joke.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 demonstrates discretion toward Mum; A3 explicitly responds by revealing the lease.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 protects the secret from the shared tablet; A5 accepts the safer channel and entrusts B with the bakery's identity and a support role.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A progressively discloses the withdrawn application, bakery lease and maternal connection as B demonstrates trustworthiness.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 converts proven discretion into a more sensitive disclosure and greater personal reliance.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A uses successively more consequential disclosures to test whether B merits a more intimate confidence.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simply delaying an explanation can resemble this card without actually testing trust through increasing sensitivity.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: B2 reports having protected A's existing confidence; A3 tests sending a more sensitive address; B4 catches a specific privacy risk before A5 reveals the bakery's family connection.

Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, because A1 checks prior handling, A3 tests a further disclosure, and A5 grants deeper confidence; logic 5, because B2's protective answer earns A3 and B4's tablet warning causes A5's call and family revelation; relationship 4, because B2 protects a sister's autonomy while B4 manages shared-device access; heightening 4, because A5 adds the mother's connection and requests B's presence at disclosure; specificity 5, because A1 identifies college plans and B4 gives a concrete leakage route; brevity 4, because A5's short acknowledgment directly earns the next confidence. beats.text: It's the same ink as your pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the pen supplier may be involved. Wider investigation.

beats.text: That ink on your new sofa must be from the delivery label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The label's dry. You signed with your fountain pen.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
